name: Rentista / Pensionado / Inversionista Residence

requirements.blocker_text: INM's Rentista category requires permanent, lawful, stable income ('rentas permanentes, licitas y estables') of at least USD 2,500/month, from foreign or domestic sources, received through a Honduran financial institution.
requirements.fix_path: Document USD 2,500/month in qualifying permanent income routed through a Honduran bank, then apply to INM.

requirements.blocker_text: INM's Pensionado category requires a stable pension of at least USD 1,500/month from abroad, transferred through a Honduran bank.
requirements.fix_path: Document a qualifying foreign pension of USD 1,500/month routed through a Honduran bank, then apply to INM.

requirements.blocker_text: INM's Inversionista category requires a minimum USD 50,000 investment in a lawful business area, plus a USD 5,000 guarantee deposit with the State Secretariat, a feasibility study, and an investment timeline.
requirements.fix_path: Invest at least USD 50,000 in a qualifying business, deposit the USD 5,000 guarantee, and submit a feasibility study to INM.

evidence_required.document: Bank statements evidencing qualifying income/investment routed through a Honduran institution

sources.title: Instituto Nacional de Migracion de Honduras -- Rentista, Pensionado, and Inversionista residence categories, income/investment thresholds, and dependent-family provisions

notes: NEW COUNTRY BUILD (Honduras). STATUS: PUBLISHED -- all three hard requirements are sourced directly to inm.gob.hn (Honduras's own migration authority), tier 1. Three genuinely distinct alternative paths modeled together in this one file: passive-permanent-income (Rentista, USD 2,500/mo, any lawful source), foreign-pension-specific (Pensionado, lower USD 1,500/mo threshold), and active-investment (Inversionista, USD 50,000 + USD 5,000 guarantee deposit) -- work_rights set 'restricted' as a conservative default since the source did not clearly state whether Rentista/Pensionado status permits any local work, only that it does not require it. leads_to_pr and pr_after_months modeled on the 'Inmigrado' permanent category also described on this same INM page, reachable after continuous qualifying residence -- the source did not give a specific month count for this transition, so pr_after_months is set 0 to reflect that these categories are themselves treated as indefinite-duration residence rather than a fixed-term permit requiring a separate PR application; this is a modeling simplification, disclosed rather than asserted as confirmed INM policy. citizenship_after_months left null since the source did not specify a residence-to-naturalization clock for these routes specifically (see hn_citizenship_naturalisation.json for the general 3-year 'other foreigners' naturalization track, which likely applies but was not explicitly cross-confirmed).
